author: SickProdigy
description: Central guild allowlisting and role, user, VIP-sponsored, and expiring feature entitlements for Sick-Cogs.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild, role, and user IDs used for access grants and sponsorship, entitlement issue and expiry timestamps, and a bounded administrative audit history. It stores no payment details or credentials. User-data deletion removes direct grants and anonymizes sponsorship and audit references.
install_msg: AccessControl installs with enforcement disabled. The bot owner should run [p]accesscontrol, configure mappings and grants, verify decisions with [p]accesscontrol check, and only then enable enforcement.
name: AccessControl
short: Central bot and premium feature access policy.
